news.title: Hot September core CPI keeps rate-hike odds alive ahead of the 27-28 Oct FOMC
news.text: September core CPI rose 0.3% m/m / 2.6% y/y, above the ~0.2%/2.5% consensus (headline 3.7% y/y, gasoline +9.1% m/m), released Wed 14 Oct. Markets read it as keeping an October hike in play; the next FOMC meeting is 27-28 Oct.

news.title: CoreWeave extends its AI-debt-jitters slide into Friday's premarket
news.text: CoreWeave fell ~13-15% Tue 14 Oct after yields on its 9.625% 2032 notes jumped toward 15% (from ~13.4% in early Oct), on investor concern over its ~$51.6B debt load against AI-infrastructure spending; the decline continued Fri 16 Oct premarket per CNBC's movers list. Not a watchlist name, but a read on Technology-sector AI-capex sentiment.
